title: Hachiken Becomes the Club Vice President
overview: The seniors from the Equestrian Club appoint Yuugo as the new vice-president against his will. Troubled about it, he later witnesses Aki crying after having a serious conversation with Ichiro and can't stop worrying about them as well, even after they tell him to forget about it.

title: Hachiken Adopts Vice Prez
overview: Yuugo finds an abandoned puppy during cleaning and decides to adopt it. However, taking care of his new dog is not an easy task, as not only he needs money for vaccines and registration, but have to train it.

title: Hachiken Jumps High
overview: The newbies from the Equestrian Club have their first jump class, but Yuugo is the only one who fails to have his horse jump an obstacle, bringing some unpleasant memories of his past to surface. Claiming that it needs more than words to have him figure out the reason why, Aki takes him to a competition where he sees some jockeys and horses in real action.

title: Minamikujou Appears
overview: Yuugo participates in his first official jumping competition. In the occasion he and Aki have a short meeting with Ayame Minamikujou, Aki's childhood friend and self-proclaimed rival, and is startled when meeting his brother again by surprise.

title: Hachiken Has His Hands Full
overview: With the Ezonoo Festival fast approaching, the Equestrian Club begins work on Ban'ei horse racing track, despite Yuugo tasking himself with way too much work. Afterwards Yuugo takes initiative and asks Aki out on a date and his feelings for her are revealed by her friends. However, on the morning of the festival, Yuugo suddenly collapses on the race track.

title: Mikage Gives It Her All
overview: Yuugo wakes up at the hospital and comes face to face with his father, who wastes no time blaming the Ezonoo institution for Yuugo's fatigue. Meanwhile, Aki and the Equestrian Club work their hardest to make the festival a success and praise Yuugo for all his hard work upon his return.

title: Komaba Stands on the Pitcher's Mound
overview: The time has come for the Regional Baseball Championship and the students cheer for Ezonoo's team, hoping for them to reach the National tournament, specially for Ichiro who is one of the team's highlights.

title: Hachiken Howls
overview: Yuugo discovers that Ichiro has lost not only the Championship, but the last chance for him to settle the debts of his farm and is forced to quit school and look for a job to help at home. Despite knowing that there is not anything he can do about it, Yuugo can't bear to accept the fact that Ichiro was forced to give up on his ambitions before he could even get the chance to fight for them.

title: The Last Milk
overview: Despite knowing that there is nothing he could do for Ichiro's sake, Yuugo claims to Aki that it is fine for them to rely on him and they pay a visit at Ichiro's farm to pay their respects as all their cows are seized to pay for their debt. However, Aki's farm is also in difficulties and when they are forced to sell all their horses, she comes with an important decision with Yuugo's support.

title: Dream
overview: Determined to follow her dream of working with horses, Aki is allowed to work under her uncle instead of inheriting her father's farm under the condition of making into college and Yuugo agrees to help her.

title: Over and Over Again
overview: Yuugo returns home to Sapporo to obtain his brother's study guides for Aki and has a frustratingly insightful encounter with his father. Afterwards Yuugo's mother visits Ezonoo to better understand the school he choose and leaves knowing that he is growing into a better person. Finally, as the winter season approaches, Yuugo and his friends begin planning their respective futures.
